asset_manifest.pose: An adult male grad student (Black race, curly black hair) wearing a white sun hat, light purple tee shirt, khaki safari vest, and white shorts laughs and points at a massive T-Rex footprint in the sand. A small green juvenile dinosaur is napping inside the track, while a stylized T-Rex with a comically expressive grin stands nearby.
